verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official Mail MCP server that connects the inbox to Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants to summarize threads, triage by Split Inbox, and draft and send emails, so the full read-triage-draft-send loop is covered by first-party docs, with a probe confirming the MCP page. Every send requires the user's explicit approval, which is a control rather than a gap. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP flow works end to end, and explicit documentation for connecting a user's own custom agent beyond 'other AI assistants'/'favorite AI tools'.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an external agent — Claude, ChatGPT, or my own — can read, triage, draft, and send my email end to end through a documented connection

citations.quote: Superhuman Mail MCP connects your inbox and calendar into Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI assistants—so you can summarize threads, draft and send emails, and schedule meetings without jumping between apps.
Connect Claude or ChatGPT directly to your inbox to read, draft, and send emails with a single prompt — no copy-pasting required.
You can also do things that are uniquely Superhuman: triage by Split Inbox, track sent emails, check Read Statuses, Smart Send, and Ask AI.
You can now drive Superhuman Mail from Claude, ChatGPT, and your favorite AI tools.
You can review the drafts in Superhuman Mail, or edit and send directly from your AI assistant.
